recommendation: Keep the source fix. It resolves concrete current-build leftovers from the published FHIR-38902 consistency request without making a separate decision for broader or still-pending related issues such as FHIR-39322 or FHIR-56063.
issue_request: FHIR-38902 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for OO. It asked to clarify consistency between Device and DeviceDefinition, including specialization/conformance modeling, DeviceDefinition.link, and DeviceDefinition value-set consistency for property.type and version.type; its resolution linked FHIR-39084 and FHIR-39322.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-38902 source commit was found. The major application was split into linked work: FHIR-39084 renamed specialization to conformsTo and added conformance search-parameter work, while FHIR-39322 commits adjusted static Device/DeviceDefinition property wording and added the DeviceDefinition.property.type binding. FHIR-39084 has already been separately reconciled on the combined branch.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-31563 originally added DeviceDefinition.link and specified that link.relation describes the relation to the defined device, but current source still said device instance. FHIR-40488 later renamed DeviceDefinition.version to DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion. FHIR-56063 later confirmed the renamed DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.type still needed the same example binding to valueset-device-versiontype as Device.deviceVersion.type. January 2023 DEV/OO notes track the seed, FHIR-39084, and FHIR-39322 as one Device/DeviceDefinition consistency workstream.
reconciliation: Updated source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml to add an example binding on DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.type to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-versiontype and to change DeviceDefinition.link.relation short/definition from device instance to defined device.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: added the FHIRDeviceVersionType example binding to DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion.type, using http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-versiontype.
source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: changed DeviceDefinition.link.relation short and definition to refer to the defined device instead of a device instance.
